Round 1

Dhoti Uddतोता उड़, मैना उड़ · धोती उड़!

Kitne khiladi? (Players)
Naam
Dadaji 90+ naam bol sakte hain (Pappu, Golu, Rahul, Priya, Dadi, Mama…). Baaki naam par woh rang bolenge: “Laal wala out!”
Jaan (Lives)
Khelne ka tarika
Level (Mushkil)
  1. Phone par: har khiladi apni ungli apne gole par dabaa ke rakhe. Laptop par (Tap karo): kuch dabaa ke nahi rakhna, udne wali cheez par apni key ek baar dabao: Z, M, Q, P.
  2. Dadaji bolenge “___ udd!”. Udne wali cheez (tota, patang, makkhi) ho to ungli utha lo, jaldi!
  3. Na udne wali (bhains, khatiya, oont) ho to dabaaye rakho. Uthaayi to galti.
  4. Galti karne wale ki ek jaan jaati hai aur Dadaji uska naam bol dete hain. Baaki khiladi khelte rehte hain.
  5. Jab sab out ho jaayein (ya bas ek bache), tab Dadaji ki dhoti udti hai!
  6. Mushkil level par Dadaji tez bolte hain aur trick wale naam zyada aate hain.
  7. Dadaji chalaaki karte hain: kabhi na udne wali cheez par bhi ungli utha dete hain. Unki ungli dekh ke mat uthaana!
